info.name: Vulpera
info.description: The Vulpera species from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: Vulpera are small, fox-like people native to the deserts of Vol’dun. Traveling in close-knit caravans, their wagons pulled by alpacas, vulpera watch out for each other as they scavenge supplies from across the dunes. Despite their small stature, they are fierce and cunning in battle, bringing down any enemy foolish enough to underestimate them.

Despite this ferocity, the vulpera have long been terrorized by the serpentine sethrak. During the Fourth War, the Horde helped a group of vulpera strike a decisive blow against their sethrak oppressors, leading the grateful vulpera to seek admittance into the Horde. After proving that they could be useful to the Horde, they were admitted.

Vulpera stand under five feet tall and resemble foxes walking upright, with slender muzzles, large ears, and bushy tails. Their fur ranges from gold or orange to white or dark gray, usually lighter on the front.
Your Renown Score with Orgrimmar (Horde) begins at 3.
As a Vulpera, you have these special traits.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
Fire Resistance. You have Resistance to Fire damage.
Nose for Trouble. The first time you take damage after you roll Initiative, you reduce the damage you take by your level (to a minimum of 0 damage).
Vulpera Nimbleness. You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.
You know Common (Alliance) or Orcish (Horde), plus two languages from the Alliance Languages or Horde Languages tables. At least one of Common or Orcish is recommended.
You have Resistance to Fire damage.
The first time you take damage after you roll Initiative, you reduce the damage you take by your level (to a minimum of 0 damage).
